title: 250-252 Kelton Avenue (Houses), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: The building, a two-family residence, is a contributing structure in the Columbus Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area containing those architectural styles favored by the upper middle class from the 1880's to the 1930's.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
